name: BRAINS-claude-usage-monitor
description: Anthropic-billable Claude Code token meter — rolling 5h / 7d windows, last-hour sparkline, configurable nudge. A BRAINS Certified extension. Reads ~/.claude/projects/ locally; no network, no telemetry.

claudeUsageMonitor.warningTokens.description: Token total at which the status bar turns yellow.

claudeUsageMonitor.criticalTokens.description: Token total at which the status bar turns red. Nudge behaviour is configured separately via claudeUsageMonitor.nudge.mode.

claudeUsageMonitor.nudge.mode.description: When to show the start-fresh-chat nudge. once-per-session = at most one per session; on-warning/on-critical = each time threshold crosses upward; on-each = every change event past minInterval; off = never.
enumDescriptions: Show at most one nudge per session, when the critical threshold is first crossed.
Show a nudge each time the warning threshold is crossed upward.
Show a nudge each time the critical threshold is crossed upward.
Show a nudge on every change event where total >= warning, subject to minInterval.

claudeUsageMonitor.nudge.minIntervalMinu.description: Minimum minutes between repeat nudges for the same session in on-warning/on-critical/on-each modes. 0 disables the gap.

claudeUsageMonitor.nudge.suppressedSessi.description: Session ids the user has asked not to be nudged again about. Add via the Snooze action on the notification.

claudeUsageMonitor.limits.sessionTokens.description: Total tokens allowed in the rolling session window. Set to null to hide percentage display.

claudeUsageMonitor.limits.weeklyTokens.description: Total tokens allowed in the rolling weekly window. Set to null to hide percentage display.

claudeUsageMonitor.limits.sessionWindowH.description: Rolling-session window length in hours (Claude.ai uses 5).

claudeUsageMonitor.refreshIntervalSecond.description: How often the hover card and sidebar refresh wall-clock fields (reset countdowns, 'X ago' timestamps) when no Claude conversation activity is happening. Minimum 5 seconds.
